decision_owner: coordinator, with the owner informed, after the per-feature cells
motivation: HORIZON_DIAGNOSTIC (cf1e59f4): corrected candidates are flat at about 0.40 MAE_z over h1..h24 with residual mean +0.07..+0.08 and dispersion 0.83 of the target, while a 24 h seasonal naive scores about 0.248 at every horizon. Diagnostic only; no batch result or incumbent changes.

common_protocol.task: ECL L24/H1..24, the same governed NPZ (train 9215b099..., validation e3712565...), z_train, author 7/1/2 borders, purge as declared
common_protocol.selection: validation MAE (frozen primary metric), strict-minimum paired-seed incumbent rule, full precision, no tolerance band
common_protocol.test_split: never read; any objective/horizon-weight change is a NEW variant identity, not a rewrite of batch d_ecl_l24_h24_corrected_r0_v1
common_protocol.comparators: the same configurations already verified in the corrected batch (paired by config and seed)

proposals.hypothesis: a train->validation level shift drives the +0.07..+0.08 bias

variants.name: seasonal_residual_target
variants.change: train on y_{t+h} - y_{t+h-24} (residual over the declared seasonal naive, computed from the input window) and add it back at scoring; identical inputs, loss and budget

variants.name: window_level_normalization
variants.change: subtract each window's last-24h mean per channel from inputs and targets (reversible, train-only parameters none); identical model and budget

proposals.identity_rule: new search-space engine label suffix and new candidate ids; evaluator settings carry the transform name and version
proposals.cost: per configuration x 2 seeds at measured rates: grouped/draw widths about 1-2 min each on the 5090 (0.0135-0.028 s/update, 1,000-6,300 updates); per-feature about 0.20 s/update x up to 8,610 updates = <= 29 min each
proposals.budget_proposal: the 4 grouped/draw configurations x 2 seeds x 2 variants = 16 cells, about 30-45 GPU-min plus verification

proposals.hypothesis: early patience at lr 1e-3 stops before horizon-specific structure is learned (several cells selected epoch 3-5)

variants.name: patience_longer
variants.change: patience 15 with min_delta 0, max_epochs 60 (hard limits unchanged otherwise); this is a new early-stop rule identity (modular.early_stop.v2 rule sha changes)

variants.name: lr_lower
variants.change: learning_rate x 0.3 of each configuration's value, everything else identical

proposals.identity_rule: new early-stop identity / evaluator settings; same model configs
proposals.cost: patience_longer up to 2x the epochs of the comparator (upper bound 60 epochs x 287 updates x measured s/update); lr_lower same bound as comparator
proposals.budget_proposal: the same 4 configurations x 2 seeds x 2 variants = 16 cells, about 45-90 GPU-min plus verification

not_proposed: horizon-weighted losses or dropping losing horizons (would need a separately declared strategy-input experiment)
